## Decision needed

State the owner choice.

## Prepared evidence

Summarize the options, experiments, and recommendations already available.

## Consequences

Describe what each choice enables, blocks, or makes irreversible.

## Owner action

- [ ] Record the selected option and rationale.
- [ ] Update downstream issues and labels.
- [ ] Promote a durable architecture choice to an ADR.
